newsitem.title: LIBERIA: Liberia parties pick presidential candidate.
newsitem.headline: Liberia parties pick presidential candidate.

text.p: An alliance of seven political parties in Liberia has chosen former minister Cletus Wotorson as its presidential candidate in elections due on May 30.
Wotorson of the Liberia Action Party was selected late on Thursday after a three-day convention, defeating better-known candidates.
He has the daunting challenge of taking on two of Liberia's former warlords, Charles Taylor and Alhaji Kromah, in the polls.
Asked what made him a better choice than Taylor, the frontrunner, Wotorson told the British Broadcasting Corporation:
"First of all, I've never carried a gun. I don't belong to any faction and I have a track record of 35 years of public and private service."
The elections are the highlight of a peace accord signed in Nigeria last August, ending a civil war that erupted in December 1989 and killed more than 150,000 people.
